description: The chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from a baseline Whisper model across various applied optimizations for two different fine-tuned models. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Optimisations applied," and lists five optimizations from bottom to top: Dates, Americanisms, Remove Spacing, Add Spacing, and Normalised. The horizontal value axis is labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to slightly above 0.003, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.001. The chart uses grouped horizontal bars, with two bars per optimization category. According to the legend labeled "Model," the orange bars represent the "NESAC ft model" and the green bars represent the "SESHA ft model." Within each category grouping, the green bar is positioned below the orange bar. Every bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numeric value at its end. For the "Dates" category, the green bar is 0.00228 (the shortest bar in the chart) and the orange bar is 0.00257. For "Americanisms," the green bar is 0.00302 and the orange bar is 0.00299. Under "Remove Spacing," the green bar reads 0.00306 and the orange bar is 0.00311. For "Add Spacing," the green bar reaches 0.00344 (the longest bar in the chart) while the orange bar is 0.00319. Finally, for the "Normalised" category, the green bar is 0.00323 and the orange bar is 0.00312. The categories do not appear to be sorted in a strict alphabetical or value-based ascending or descending order.
